batch_config.name: ode_forced_collapse_extreme_scan_v1
batch_config.purpose: Force the local ODE system toward collapse by removing residue support, starving growth, and applying extreme suppression so collapse can either be observed or meaningfully resisted.

paper_alignment.paper_question: Under what conditions does the local epsilon-rho-R system sustain persistent nonzero structure rather than collapsing or washing out?
paper_alignment.reason_for_this_batch: The prior ODE persistence boundary scan found no collapse_to_pressure cases. This batch deliberately pushes the system far outside the previously tested region.

assumptions_for_agent: Agent should preserve all existing solver functions unless explicit incompatibility requires additive extension only.
If exact runtime schema differs, adapt field names minimally while preserving the parameter content and sweep intent.
All classifier thresholds must be emitted in manifest or config snapshot.
Do not hide resolved defaults in code; write all resolved parameter values into each run manifest.

initial_condition_families.name: tiny_epsilon_pressure_favored
initial_condition_families.notes: Strongly favors epsilon extinction if collapse is available.

initial_condition_families.name: small_epsilon_pressure_dominant
initial_condition_families.notes: More moderate version of collapse-favoring start.

initial_condition_families.name: moderate_balanced
initial_condition_families.notes: Retained for contrast with the collapse-favoring starts.

scan_stages.goal: Remove support entirely and starve epsilon growth.
scan_stages.expected_value: Determines whether the local system can collapse with residue support disabled and growth weakened.

scan_stages.goal: Overpower epsilon with very strong coupling and self-limiting terms.
scan_stages.expected_value: Tests whether aggressive suppression terms can extinguish epsilon even without residue support.

scan_stages.goal: Let rho dominate while epsilon growth remains weak.
scan_stages.expected_value: Checks whether strong pressure maintenance plus weak epsilon growth drives collapse_to_pressure.

scan_stages.goal: Combine weak growth, no residue, and extreme suppression in one aggressive search.
scan_stages.expected_value: If collapse exists in the current formulation, this stage should have a strong chance of revealing it.

minimum_success_conditions: At least one collapse_to_pressure case is observed, OR
No collapse is observed even under the combined extreme break test and that resistance is documented as a result.
target_figures: timeseries comparison: robust persistence vs strongest collapse candidate
regime table or heatmap from extreme suppression slices
diagnostic summary showing whether collapse remains absent under extreme forcing

notes_to_agent: If collapse_to_pressure is found in any early stage, refine around that local boundary before exhausting all later stages.
If no collapse is found in any stage, emit diagnostic_note.md stating that the tested local ODE system appears structurally collapse-resistant under extreme suppression and zero residue support.
Negative rho values should not be silently accepted as physically meaningful; emit a flag column rho_negative_flag in summaries.
All run ids should include stage_id and initial_condition_family.
This batch is designed to break the system, not merely probe it.
